explanation: I searched Mathlib for declarations about subsingleton sets having measure zero. I tried `Subsingleton.measure_zero`, `measure_subsingleton`, and patterns of the form `Subsingleton ... μ ... = 0` under MeasureTheory. The only hit is the target itself, plus one use of it in NumberTheory/LSeries/AbstractFuncEq. Other results in the same file, such as `Set.Countable.measure_zero` and `Set.Finite.measure_zero`, are more general or come later in the file and are proved from singletons. They do not give this statement in one or two lines. I found no independent declaration that matches.
